solver.arithmetic: float64, compensated scalar sums, fixed-order Cholesky and coordinate updates
solver.diagnostic_scope: Floating-point stationarity and objective diagnostics, not interval-certified optimization proofs

acceptance.canonical_reference: macOS arm64; exact OS, architecture, Python and dependency versions recorded in receipts
acceptance.coefficient_and_iteration_equality: Diagnostic only; saved parameters must satisfy bounds and numerical convergence checks, and reproduce their saved maps
acceptance.full_budget_repeat_rule: All six runs have identical full-budget inputs and folds; require identical saved fit/prediction/metric hashes within each OS and count one full endpoint per source case in aggregates
acceptance.unchanged_label_control_rule: Across paired weighting conditions require exact evaluation predictions for electronic, pop and rock for every method, and exact ridge OOF probabilities/choices for these labels

historical_v1_comparison.role: Retained diagnostic of the numerical implementation change; never a gate requiring recovery of v1 model selections or scores
historical_v1_comparison.platt_and_temperature_historical_error: Record, do not enforce v1 fitted coefficients or predictions

freeze_rule: Hash all six child configs/plans, input data, protocol, solver, portable engine, execution driver and comparison sources before fitting any full study run
interpretation: Engineering reproduction study on previously observed data; no fresh holdout, new method, hyperparameter tuning, accuracy-improvement claim or application change
